l2_steps.text:
For each baseline, update the training pipeline with the method and run it.
Record the accuracy, F1 score, and training time for each baseline.
All operations should be done in the notebook, not locally.
l2_steps.criteria: Before moving to each new baseline, preserves the previous baseline's implementation code and evaluation results (overwriting the training cell and re-running the evaluation cell destroys the previous baseline's code and output)

why_backup: The model training cell (Cell 2) contains the baseline implementation code. The evaluation cell (Cell 3) contains the metrics output. When the agent overwrites Cell 2 with a new baseline and re-executes Cell 3, both the previous baseline's code (in Cell 2) and its evaluation output (in Cell 3) are permanently lost. Without preserving each baseline's implementation and results before proceeding, the agent cannot reconstruct the final comparison table.
